type ai.ContextUsageEstimate struct
fields:
- Tokens int64 tag="json:\"tokens\""
- UsageTokens int64 tag="json:\"usageTokens\""
- TrailingTokens int64 tag="json:\"trailingTokens\""
- LastUsageIndex *int tag="json:\"lastUsageIndex\""

func ai.EstimateContextTokens func(ai.Context) ai.ContextUsageEstimate

func ai.GetOverflowPatterns func() []*regexp.Regexp

func ai.IsContextOverflow func(ai.AssistantMessage, ...int64) bool
